name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A complete step-by-step method (spec it, plan it, build it, review it) that turns an AI coding agent into a disciplined junior engineering team.
buyer: A non-technical founder who wants to build real software with AI agents but needs guardrails so it doesn't go off the rails for hours.
business_use_cases: A non-technical founder uses it to have an AI agent build their MVP with proper specs and tests instead of unreviewed vibe-coding.
A small agency standardizes client delivery on this methodology to reduce AI-introduced bugs.
An enterprise buys commercial support to get managed spending controls on top of the open framework.

money_ideas.idea: Sell enterprise commercial support, as the project itself already hints at (managed spending, extra tooling).
Offer a 'go from idea to shipped app' coaching package for non-technical founders using the method.

steal_this: This weekend, offer a flat-fee 'ship your MVP with AI, done right' package to a non-technical founder, using this methodology as your process.
